_doc: One entry per clip (DESIGN 6.5). clip: the clip id = the file name and SettingsDial.Explainer (the dial id unless shared). dial: the registry id `setting id=` writes. kind: state (before value, the change, after value), motion (the dial at `value` while `action` plays; `takes` for more than one), diagram (a sound dial: `diagram` names the drawing, in the theme's colours read from the app). themes: "all" or a list (theme options only in their theme). status: recorded, needs <branch>, or not recordable headless, and why (the badge registry, Screens/SettingsExplain.cs, lists exactly the recorded ones). w, h, scale, route, mountArgs, setup: the surface (the mount, extra mount args, inspector lines run after the mount). before/after: dial values (a choice's index, a toggle's true|false, a slider's number; after may be a list of steps, each held). sweep: seconds to move a slider from before to after through its values. region: what to crop: keys (node keys from `find`, `key#n` for the nth match; their union over both states) or rect [x,y,w,h] DIP; pad; fit contain|width|height; focus (a key the crop centres on); anchor left|right|top|bottom (hold the crop to that edge of the union); clamp "keys" (stay inside the union); within (a key or rect the crop stays inside where it fits, e.g. shell.content.card); minWidth (DIP, default 320 = 640 px at scale 2); dx/dy. Any field, and any region field, may be a dict keyed by theme ({"winui": ..., "default": ...}). Timing: step (engine frames per capture, 16 ms each), capture (max seconds of change), stillFrames, watch ("region": judge stillness on the region keys, not the window; "none": never still, the whole capture is the change, for a countdown whose digit and thin bar move too little to judge), rest (frames after the settle), hold (s), quality (where the encode starts; dim text on a dim ground wants more than 70: lossy smears it into a blur of its own), slow (motion slowed for legibility), maxStill (s: a still stretch inside the change is cut to this, e.g. a start delay), fps. pending: {branch, part, why}: part surface (the surface is on another branch), dial (the dial is on another branch), inspector (the headless inspector cannot stage it yet) or effect (the app shows no change in one app mode, and a badge needs both) is skipped until it lands (--pending tries it; a missing dial then records at the build's default when withoutDial is "record"). sharedWith: dials whose badge shows this clip. todo: what to settle when the entry is recorded for the first time.

clips.why: a music video ending in full screen with another video queued: the end card counts down "Up next in 5" over the stage instead of cutting to the next. player=scripted plays tr26 as video; `transport do=end` is the natural end (settle=false, or the settle waits out the whole countdown and the advance). Headless the picture is the stage's ground (no frames decode offline); the card is the change; the setup waits until the playing video's chrome has gone idle (frames 400), as it is when a video plays out, so the end brings the card and the chrome back together

playing, not paused (a paused rail shows a blur write one write late); line 7 of tr1 is active from 31.0 s to 34.2 s: the rest lets its scroll land, the clip ends before the next line; the crop holds the active line at its top (line 7 in every theme: Zune's rail lays the same lines out taller) with the lines after it, so the clip shows the sharp line against the ones the dial blurs; Classic records at scale 1: its rail blurs by device pixels, so at scale 2 the same dial blurs half as far and the change is hard to see (the blur a 100 % display shows)

the AI times a song that has no word timing: the fake lyrics answer line-synced (mount lyrics=line), the rail lights a whole line at once; `state kind=ai ai=timed words=on` then gives the song a finished job's word timing through the store upgrade a cached result takes, and from the next line on the rail wipes word by word (the AI disclosure appears under it). A view holds the upgrade until the line hands off, so the action lands mid-line 7 of tr1 (31.0-34.0 s; in the gap before line 8 the upgrade can miss the handoff) and the still stretch before line 8 is cut

the dial changes the whole full screen, so the crop is the stage (a 1280x720 window, 16:9 already); the layouts are the Visualizer mode's (Card, Large art, Centered, Artist): the Lyrics mode keeps its own arrangement whatever the dial says; the visualizer never holds still, so each step is capped at 0.6 s; the gallery closed and the chrome held (gallery=off chrome=shown), so only the layout changes between steps
the dial shows only for the Large art and Centered layouts
the mini player is its own window, so the crop is that window (mounted 16:9)
